subject: Staged quality ops migration plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staged quality ops migration plan

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attached is a concise staged plan for migrating Acme Health to Redwood's Quality Ops (high-level PDF + a sample prompt set CSV). The goal is to get prompt-level regressions visible in your dashboard and to establish safe canary/rollback controls before full traffic cutover.

Key proposal (high level):
- Phase 0 (inventory): sanitize and version your existing prompt sets; tag by SLO impact.
- Phase 1 (eval harness + telemetry): wire your traffic to our eval harness (shadow mode) and map our eval metrics to your SLOs.
- Phase 2 (alerts & canary): configure regression alerts + run a 2-week canary (1% -> 10% traffic ramp) with pre-defined rollback criteria.
- Phase 3 (cutover & monitoring): full roll, weekly quality reviews for first month.

What I need from you to start kickoff:
1) a primary engineering contact for the technical kickoff
2) a sanitized sample of your current prompt sets (we can take care of PII sanitization if you prefer)
3) your target SLOs for correctness/latency so we can map alert thresholds

I've attached: qmon-staged-plan-v1.pdf (plan), sample-promptsets.csv (example format).

Proposed kickoff: 2028-03-28 (one week from today) — 60-minute technical kickoff. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qmon-staged-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 470KB), sample-promptsets.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged quality ops migration plan

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. A few quick questions before we lock the kickoff: 
- Can you map Redwood's eval metrics to our internal SLOs (FTR: first-time-right) and provide a short mapping doc?
- On the eval harness integration: do you need production traffic replay or can we provide a sampled dataset?
- For the canary thresholds — what defaults do you recommend for a healthcare workload (sensitivity vs. false positives)?
- We also need to complete a short security questionnaire; I attached it here.

Assuming we can get answers on the above, 3/28 should work for a kickoff. Please copy our engineering lead if the kickoff will include deep infra topics.

Best,
Alice
Director of Product
Acme Health

Attachments: security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Subject: Re: Staged quality ops migration plan

Team — looping you in to run the implementation. Alice asked good clarifying questions (mapping to SLOs, sample vs replay traffic, canary defaults for healthcare). My suggested owners and next steps: 

- Monica (CS lead): owner for prompt set sanitization, SLO mapping doc, and compliance coordination with Acme — due 2028-03-24.
- Marissa (Implementation lead): eval harness wiring & instrumentation in shadow mode, initial alert rule set — due 2028-03-25.
- Karthik (AE): coordinate kickoff scheduling, confirm legal/security pre-reqs.

Implementation sprint (week-by-week):
Wk0 (this week): inventory + sanitize prompt sets; define 6-8 key eval metrics mapped to Acme SLOs
Wk1: eval harness integration (shadow) + baseline collection; configure regression alert templates
Wk2: staged canary (1% -> 10%); daily automated checks + manual review checkpoints; rollback criteria documented (30% drop in FTR or >2x latency at p95)
Wk3: decision point — proceed to cutover or extend canary.

Action items for kickoff (3/28):
- Monica: bring sanitized prompt sets + SLO mapping doc
- Marissa: bring eval harness runbook and sample telemetry dashboard
- Alice/Bob: provide access for a read-only traffic sample / replay artifact if available

I filed a short JIRA to track tasks: SUP-9421 (link in thread). 

Is everyone comfortable with the owners and dates above? If so I'll send the official calendar invite for 3/28 and attach the JIRA and a short runbook excerpt.

Thanks —
Karthik

Date: 2028-03-21T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged quality ops migration plan

Quick update from the implementation side — noted owners and dates. A couple specifics: 
- I'll provision the eval harness sandbox and pre-populate it with a synthetic replay by 2028-03-24; this will let us measure baseline eval metrics without touching prod.
- Monica: if you can send the sanitized prompt sets by EOD 3/23 I can start wiring mappings on 3/24 and have first dashboards by 3/25.
- Suggested canary defaults for healthcare (we can tighten during kickoff): rollback if FTR drops >20% relative to baseline OR if p95 latency increases >2x for 30m. We'll surface alerts to the on-call and to the CS dashboard.

I'm tagging SUP-9421 with the implementation checklist and will attach the runbook excerpt before kickoff.

— Marissa
